_note: Example Stupp-protocol config: the StuppFKPPSolver parameters by name (fisher_kpp_jax.read_config, then StuppFKPPSolver(config)). Keys starting with '_' are comments. Volumes are NIfTI paths, absolute or relative to this file. Optional parameters not listed take the class defaults (fisher_kpp_jax/configs/StuppFKPPSolver.json lists them all).
_clock: Times are days: t=0 is the tumor seed, the simulated growth before surgery is resection_time, the total simulated time is resection_time + time_after_resection.
_schedule: seed (day 0) --> resection (day 100) --> recovery (days 100-114) --> radiotherapy: 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks (days 114-153, Monday = day 114); concomitant TMZ 75 mg/m^2 daily INCLUDING weekends over the same 6 weeks (days 114-155, 42 sessions) --> 4-week break --> adjuvant TMZ on days 1-5 of six 28-day cycles starting 4 weeks after the last fraction (day 181): days 181-185, 209-213, 237-241, 265-269, 293-297, 321-325; 150 mg/m^2 in cycle 1, 200 mg/m^2 in cycles 2-6 (72 sessions in total) --> growth to day 360 (35 days after the last dose).
_growth: rho in 1/day, white_matter_diffusivity in mm^2/day (gray matter: divided by diffusivity_ratio). Any other scalar StuppFKPPSolver parameter may be set under its name (e.g. gaussian_seed_mass, min_tissue_fraction, stopping_threshold).
_time_step: At most one of steps_per_day, dt (days) or n_steps; a step coarser than the solver's stability estimate is raised to the estimate with a warning.
_resection: resection_cavity: the voxels of the label in the segmentation.
_chemotherapy: chemo_doses in mg/m^2, one per session (each session deposits a concentration equal to its dose); chemo_kill_rate in 1/day per mg/m^2 (PLACEHOLDER: the previous unit-concentration value 0.47 / 75 mg/m^2, so a 75 mg/m^2 session kills as before); chemo_decay_rate in 1/day (> 0).
_radiotherapy: rt_dose NIfTI in Gy, TOTAL over all fractions (per-fraction dose = rt_dose / len(rt_times)); rt_alpha in 1/Gy, rt_alpha_beta_ratio in Gy (the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio; the solver derives rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio in 1/Gy^2, it is not a config entry; 10 Gy is the class default, the one treatment parameter with a default).
